title: The Fall of King Zhou
lines: King Zhou of Shang was once a wise and powerful ruler. But on a visit to the temple of the goddess Nuwa, he was overcome with lust at the beauty of her statue and wrote a lewd poem on the temple wall.
Nuwa, enraged by this blasphemy, summoned three demon sisters — the Thousand-Year Fox Spirit, the Nine-Headed Pheasant, and the Jade Pipa Spirit — and commanded them to bring about Zhou's downfall.

The fox spirit possessed the body of the most beautiful woman in the kingdom, Da Ji. When she was presented to King Zhou, he was instantly captivated. Da Ji's cruelty knew no bounds. She invented tortures for her own amusement.
